results.question: How many open items mention "security" in title or body?

results.question: How many of the 500 records are pull requests?
results.command: cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => r.is_pr) | len

results.question: Total comments across all closed items.

results.question: Which author opened the most PRs, and how many?

results.question: Numbers of open non-PR issues with more than 5 comments, sorted.

results.question: How many open items carry the "bug" label?

results.question: Largest comment count on any item.
results.command: cat("issues.json") | from_json | map(fn(r) => r.comments) | max

results.question: How many authors have opened both a PR and an issue?

let iss = cat("issues.json") | from_json | where(fn(r) => !r.is_pr) | map(fn(r) => r.user) | unique
